subject: general
question: With respect to sports, NADA stands for ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**National Anti-Doping Agency.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **NADA **stands for National Anti-Doping Agency.
 
• It is the national organization responsible for** promoting, coordinating, and monitoring** the doping control program in sports in India.
 
• NADA works towards **creating awareness **about the harmful effects of doping and ensuring that sports remain clean and fair.
 
• It conducts** dope testing of athletes**, maintains a database of athletes, and also provides education and training to athletes and coaches about anti-doping rules and regulations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• NADA is not an autonomous organization but is under the** Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports.**
